channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: K-beauty, Middle Eastern Fragrances, Wellness Patches Excited Buyers at Cosmoprof Miami
item.description: Taking place at Miami Beach Convention Center, Miami Cosmoprof featured the largest selection of K-beauty and fragrance to date.

item.title: Layer Zero to Offer Skims-like Shapewear at More Affordable Price
item.description: The collection created by the founder of 32 Degrees will launch online and at Costco on Feb. 10.

item.title: How Nutrafol Plans to Supercharge Its Men’s Business
item.description: The brand is introducing a hair growth supplement for men ages 50-plus as it looks to boost its minority— but highly loyal — male customer base.

item.title: DTC Traffic Is Still Growing in Beauty — It Just Depends Where
item.description: The top 10 beauty companies by direct-to-consumer traffic growth in 2025 indicate high interest in research-grade peptides, digitally native supplement brands and more.

item.title: Interparfums SA Brings Solférino Paris to the U.S.
item.description: First launched last July, the brand offers Interparfums a line to the fast-growing niche fragrance consumer.

item.title: Tree Hut’s Parent Company Is Launching a Gen Alpha Bath Brand
item.description: Called Splash, the line is part of Naterra's plan to diversify its business beyond Tree Hut's hero body scrubs.

item.title: TikTok Shop’s Ajay Salpekar: ‘We’re Just Scratching the Surface’
item.description: The platform's general manager of beauty joined the WWD Beauty of Tomorrow podcast to talk growth, K-beauty, fragrance and more.

item.title: Theory’s New Spring Campaign Stars Molly Gordon and Ken Leung
item.description: The campaign explores New York, not only as a backdrop but as a mindset.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: RH Expands Outdoor Collection With Its Roster of International Designers
item.description: With its new Outdoor Sourcebook, RH deepens its collaboration with Los Angeles-based Ann Marie Vering, Sydney’s Nicholas and Harrison Condos, Spanish designer Mario Ruiz and Milan-based furniture-maker Arthur Gentil.

item.title: Bottega Veneta Has a New Global Marketing and Communications Director
item.description: Emilie Leblanc was most recently global communications director at Celine in Paris. She spent most of her career at Saint Laurent in Paris.
